summary: Submitted the successor execution of the restart/durable-vote discriminator with previous_id 79eba5e015d84914afd69dac65a62430-experiment and the change of basis recorded: the target is now isolated from its real peers before any probe (cluster transport-level Disconnect) and reached only through a dedicated InmemTransport connected to the target's own transport, with the post-restart probes issued with no sleep so they fall inside the target's election-timer window. Each probe reports granted plus delivered, and the harness emits an explicit applicability flag (restored currentTerm == probe term and durable LastVoteTerm == probe term) so an inapplicable run is visible in the receipt instead of being misread as a denial. The harness compiles cleanly against the snapshot (go vet in the local fixed-input workspace); interpretation is left for the retained controller receipt.
